apiKeys.title: AI agent
apiKeys.intro: An AI agent logged in as you acts on your account. Each API key you create carries its OWN scope — exactly what that key's sessions may do across OpenStoa. There is no account-wide AI permission any more: create a key with the scope you want, then edit or revoke it any time. Your own actions are never restricted.

Public rooms reload in full straight away.
recovery.title: Chat recovery
recovery.intro: End-to-end encrypted chat keys live only on your devices. Set up recovery so you can restore your history if you lose them. We never see your keys.
recovery.statusNotSetUp: Not set up — you could permanently lose chat history if you lose your devices.
recovery.secureUnavailable: Secure storage is unavailable, so backup is disabled here.
recovery.writeItDown: Write this down. It is shown only once:
recovery.passkeyNoBackup: Recovery failed — this passkey has no backup on file.
recovery.keysPending: The chat keys have not arrived yet. The recovery itself is done and the keys are fetched again on their own — there is no need to recover a second time.

recoveryNudge.title: Back up your chat keys
recoveryNudge.body: Your encrypted chat history can only be read with keys held on your devices. Lose them without a backup and every message is gone for good — no one, including us, can bring it back.

none.heading: Your chats are locked to this phone
none.body:
Every message in your rooms is encrypted with a key that exists only on this device. There is no copy of it — not on our servers, not anywhere.

If this phone is reset or replaced, if you erase the app's data from Profile, or — on Android — if you reinstall the app, that key goes with it, and none of these conversations can be opened again by anyone, including us.

Profile → Chat recovery makes a recovery key you can keep somewhere else. It takes a moment, and it is the only thing that undoes this.

unopenable.heading: Your recovery key would not open these chats
unopenable.body:
This account has a recovery key, but the chat keys on this phone are not inside the backup that key restores — it was made under a different key, and this device cannot add to it without destroying it.

As it stands, recovering would bring the account back and leave these conversations unreadable.

Open Profile → Chat recovery on this phone and set recovery up again from here.

noBackup.title: Back up on your other phone first
noBackup.body:
Signing in here ends the session on your other phone, and your chat keys stay there — they do not travel with your account. Without a backup, the private rooms it joined become unreadable on both phones, permanently.

The only device that can still make that backup is the one that is signed in right now. Open ZKProofport on it, go to Profile → Chat recovery, and come back.

staleBackup.title: Your backup is {{days}} days old
staleBackup.body: Rooms you joined since then are not in it, and neither is anything sent in them. If your other phone is still signed in, backing up again on it takes a moment and keeps everything — it is the only device that can, and only while it is still signed in.

ready.title: This will sign out your other phone
ready.body: Your chat keys stay on that phone, so after signing in here you will need to restore from your backup to read your rooms. Anything that happened after its last backup is not in it — for private, secret and direct rooms, another member has to hand those keys over before that stretch becomes readable.

firstRunRecovery.title: Save your recovery key
firstRunRecovery.bodyFirstRun: Your chat history is encrypted with keys that live on this phone and nowhere else. This key is the only way to read it again on another device — or on this one, if it is ever reset.
firstRunRecovery.bodyNoBackup: This account has no recovery key. Without one, losing this phone means losing every encrypted conversation on it — no one, including us, can bring it back.
firstRunRecovery.warning: A copy stays in your own space — but it is locked by the same key, so it is not a backup. Keep one outside this app.

firstRunRecovery.noteWarning: Keep a copy OUTSIDE this app. This message is encrypted with the same keys it protects — if this phone loses them, you will not be able to read this either.

deviceData.title: Device data
deviceData.row: Clear cache, or erase this device

clearCache.title: Clear cache
clearCache.explain: Frees up space by deleting copies this device can download again: decrypted messages, room history, the room list and saved pictures. Your keys are not touched, and every room stays open — the next visit is just slower.
clearCache.confirmBody: Everything deleted here comes back from the server the next time you open a room. Your chat keys and room memberships are not affected.

eraseDevice.title: Erase from this device
eraseDevice.explain: Deletes everything OpenStoa keeps on this phone, including the chat keys. This device is signed out and can no longer read any room it is in.
eraseDevice.backupFirst: Back up your keys first — Profile → Chat recovery. Without a backup this cannot be undone by anyone, including us.
eraseDevice.confirmBody: The chat keys on this phone will be deleted and you will be signed out. You can get your rooms back by signing in again and restoring from your backup.
eraseDevice.staleBackupBody: Your last key backup was {{days}} days ago. Any room you joined since then is not in it, and those rooms will be unreadable after this. Rooms covered by the backup can be restored after signing in again.
eraseDevice.noBackupBody: There is no backup of this device's chat keys. Back them up first — Profile → Chat recovery — and this becomes reversible.
eraseDevice.finalBody: Erasing without a backup permanently destroys this device's chat history. No one can recover it — not another device, not the server, not us.
